item.title: Overcome Experience Barriers 🚀 • Use: “I led a team to increase sales by 20% in 6 months.” • Focus on specific achievements, not just job titles. • Highlight skills and results relevant to the role. • Quantify your impact with data or percentages. • Show adaptability and learning agility. How can you reframe your achievements to emphasize impact over duration? #career #jobsearch #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
